text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, while Mejiro Dober was eating 
lunch, Air Groove consulted her about 
aromatherapy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...If you're looking for something for 
headaches, lavender or bargamot might be a 
good choice...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I recommend using it as a clay pack 
before bed. It's very relaxing, so...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A clay pack, huh... Thank you, I'll give 
it a try. Your knowledge exceeds its 
reputation, truly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? "Better than the rumors say"... who 
did you hear—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Me, of course! I wanted everyone to know 
how amazing Dober is!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Taiki!? No way, my knowledge of 
aromatherapy isn't nearly that 
impressive..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so modest! Beauty, health... even 
studying and sleep! You know so much about 
all of it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"You should share that amazing knowledge 
with everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No, well, I'm glad you'd say that, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... do you have a moment? Dober, you 
know a lot about aromatherapy, right...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Just a bit. ...So, what's troubling 
you, Suzuka...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's not really for me, but Spe-chan's 
stomach is always grumbling, and I feel so 
bad for her... Do you have an aroma that 
stops people from getting hungry?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Reduce it...? I've heard of the 
opposite... Well, if I had to pick, maybe 
mint? And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, wherever she went, students 
facing dilemmas began coming to her for 
help...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I haven't been getting much sleep 
lately~. Maybe some aromatherapy to help 
me snooze, or—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll take an aroma that keeps you 
awake! I happen to have a troublesome girl 
who is always dozing off!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright. Both of you go smell 
some geraniums and calm your nerves."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you have muscle soreness, a beeswax 
cream blended with lavender and tea 
tree...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Beeswax...? It sounds like honey, so it 
must be delicious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's not honey, so you can't eat it, 
okay...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, after everything that 
happened, Mejiro Dober looked completely 
exhausted."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Finally, I can relax...
choice_data_list: You really know an awful lot.
You really know an awful lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "I-It's nothing. No big deal, right?"
choice_data_list: How do you know so much about it?
How do you know so much about it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thanks. I hope it helps everyone.
choice_data_list: How do you know so much about it?
How do you know so much about it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There's no reason... ...It was just 
necessary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I wanted to become an 
expert... It's just that without 
aromatherapy, things get really tough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A nice scent helps you relax... and forget 
all the bad things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A nice scent helps you relax... and forget 
all the bad things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I gained all kinds of knowledge thinking 
it would protect me, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"To think that it would be needed so 
desperately..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe it'd be good to try expanding my 
knowledge even more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Why are you looking so happy...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"You think so? Then... maybe I will. I 
want to be able to give better advice, 
after all..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Or what? You got something on your mind 
too?"
choice_data_list: What do you usually use, Dober?

I'd like you to choose your 
recommendation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah. Trainer, is there anything 
troubling you? I'm here if you want to 
talk.
choice_data_list: What do you usually use, Dober?

I'd like you to choose your 
recommendation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
H-Haaah...!? Who cares what it is! Why do 
you even want to know... !?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Mine...? No, mine's fine. It's kinda 
embarrassing, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wait, are you really that depressed 
about it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wait, are you really that depressed 
about it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's the shops I usually go to, I 
can tell you about them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If it's that place, they're really 
accommodating about all sorts of things...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, when I headed to the shop 
recommended by Mejiro Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: Are you going to an aroma shop?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! What a coincidence.
choice_data_list: Are you going to an aroma shop?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ......Well, now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. I just felt like buying a new 
one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But... you don't really get aroma stuff, 
right? I mean, if it's just a little 
bit... um. ...I wouldn't mind teaching 
you, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, let's go together. I'll 
pick out an aroma tailored to your needs."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, with Mejiro Dober's guidance, 
we bought some lovely aromatic oils.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, with Mejiro Dober's guidance, 
we bought some lovely aromatic oils.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A recommendation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...You're not managing your sleep 
schedule, and you're not keeping track of 
your nutritional balance either, are you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"You haven't been getting enough sleep 
from work lately, right? I've actually 
been worried about your nutritional 
balance, too..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I think we should start by sorting out our 
daily lifestyle first, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I think we should start by sorting out our 
daily lifestyle first, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
In that case, maybe I should use sweet 
marjoram or something to help fix my 
rhythm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"In that case... maybe something relaxing 
like sweet marjoram?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“Still, seeing you at your desk all day, 
your lower back must be strained, too... 
Maybe some eucalyptus or rosemary would 
help...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“Still, seeing you at your desk all day, 
your lower back must be strained, too... 
Maybe some eucalyptus or rosemary would 
help...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Yeah. It might be better if you 
smell it for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You have that "I don't get it" look on 
your face... *sigh*. Just go wait in the 
Trainer's office for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Could you wait in the trainer's office for 
a bit? I'll go grab what I've got on hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Dober brought a massive 
amount of aromatic oils to the Trainer's 
Office...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Dober brought a massive 
amount of aromatic oils to the Trainer's 
Office...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
How is it? That was eucalyptus. It feels 
just like being in a forest—relaxing, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...And this one is sweet marjoram. You 
can feel your body gradually warming up, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, why don't you try this rose absolute? 
It brings a wonderfully deep sense of 
calm.
choice_data_list: If we do any more, I'll fall asleep...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Look at that sloppy face. I mean, you 
could just go to sleep like that, but..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly, just like that. That's what 
relaxing is all about...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She continued testing different aromas on 
me after that, leading to the best nap I 
had ever taken.
